Plot a Changepoint Task

Source: R/autoplot.R
autoplot.TaskCpt.Rd

Draws each sequence of a TaskCpt as a line, one facet per row id, with its label regions shaded by annotation. Changepoint labels use penaltyLearning::change.colors; peak labels (noPeaks, peakStart, peakEnd, peaks) use the palette of the PeakError::PeakError() example. Labels outside these vocabularies are drawn grey.

Every row with role "use" gets a facet, so to plot part of a large task, filter a copy first: task$clone()$filter(rows).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'TaskCpt'
autoplot(object, theme = ggplot2::theme_minimal(), ...)

Arguments

object

(TaskCpt).

theme

(ggplot2::theme())
The ggplot2::theme_minimal() is applied by default.

...

(ignored).

Value

ggplot2::ggplot().

Examples

library(data.table)
set.seed(36)
toy = data.table(
  seq = list(c(rnorm(100, 18), rnorm(100, 36), rnorm(100, 9)), rnorm(100, 0)),
  label = list(
    data.table(start = c(90, 190), end = c(110, 210), label = c("1change", "1change")),
    data.table(start = 1, end = 100, label = "0changes")
  )
)
task = TaskCpt$new(
  id = "toy", backend = toy,
  target = "label", sequence = "seq", label_type = "changepoint"
)
ggplot2::autoplot(task)
